messages:
Asha K: quick heads-up — HelioCloud confirmed the marketplace listing window for May 12. They want a co-post + a joint webinar within the first two weeks after listing.
Ben G: awesome. do we have a suggested narrative? marketplace listing + latency/cost benchmark angle?
Diego P: yes — partner wants emphasis on private deployment options for regulated customers. let's push a benchmark showing 2x cost reduction with caching on their infra.
Clara C: for the blog co-post, i'd propose: 1) customer problem, 2) what HelioCloud + Redwood solves, 3) short benchmark table, 4) call to action to register for webinar.
Elliot S: routing note — all inbound registrations must go to SFDC with lead source = "HelioCloud Marketplace" and campaign = "heliocloud-may12". can we add a hubspot form that POSTs to our webhook?
Marina O: Jamie from ops will own the webhook. FYI: our standard mapping: utm_source=heliocloud, utm_medium=partner, utm_campaign=heliocloud-may12.
Asha K: Clara, can you draft the co-post outline by EOD Friday? i'll sync with Diego on the benchmark data requirements.
Clara C: on it. sample headline ideas: "Faster, cheaper LLM inference on HelioCloud with Redwood" or "How HelioCloud customers cut inference costs by half" — leaning towards the first. thoughts?
Ben G: first is safer for SEO and neutral. second is too strong unless benchmark fully supports it.
Diego P: benchmark ask: need 3 workloads (chat, batch-embeddings, rerank) on medium seq length. want raw numbers + methodology. i'll send the dataset and run plan by tomorrow.
Elliot S: for the webinar, 30–40 minute format: 20m demo + 10m best practices + 10m Q/A. we should capture a short demo of the HelioCloud marketplace flow (install -> get key -> run inference).
Marina O: ops checklist for launch: 1) marketplace listing approved, 2) demo env provisioned, 3) webhook for leads tested, 4) SSO demo account, 5) social assets scheduled. i'll make a docs checklist in the repo.
Clara C: draft CTA snippets: "Register for the joint webinar" + "Try the HelioCloud listing" + short form copy. will add sample UTM links. example: `https://redwood.com/demo?utm_source=heliocloud&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=heliocloud-may12`
Asha K: small ask to product/content: can we get a short customer quote (or beta user) to include in the post? even a 1–2 sentence line helps conversion.
Diego P: we have a beta user willing to speak at the webinar, will confirm by Thursday.
marketing-bot: reminder — marketing calendar event created: "HelioCloud co-marketing launch" on 2025-05-12 09:00 UTC.
Ben G: ok next steps: Clara outline + blog draft (EOD Fri), Diego benchmark plan (tomorrow), Marina ops checklist (Mon), Elliot webinar runbook + invite list (Mon). i'll set a quick 15m sync on Tue to align.
Asha K: thanks team — i'll loop in partner marketing at HelioCloud (cc Diego) and request approval windows.
Clara C: adding a note — let's prepare two versions of the blog: long-form (benchmarks + methodology) and short partner post. split helps partner channels.
Elliot S: also let's ensure the registration flow tags the leads with persona (SaaS Platform / ML Platform / Enterprise) so SDRs can prioritize.
Marina O: will add persona field to webhook payload. sample JSON: ```{ "lead_source": "HelioCloud Marketplace", "utm_campaign": "heliocloud-may12", "persona": "ML Platform" }```
Asha K: perfect. i'll update the campaign brief and share the partner-facing timeline by EOD. :rocket:
Diego P: sounds good. i'll start the benchmark runs and ping results here.
Clara C: thanks — will post the first draft link when ready. :memo:
